summary.text: Nathan Magsig is a Republican member of the Fresno County Board of Supervisors, representing District 5 since 2017, and the Republican candidate for California State Senate District 12 in the November 3, 2026 general election against Libertarian William Brown Jr.

paragraphs.text: Nathan Magsig assumed office on the Fresno County Board of Supervisors in 2017, and his current term ends January 8, 2029.
He won re-election outright in the nonpartisan primary for District 5 on March 3, 2020, and again on March 5, 2024, when he defeated Jennifer Cruz.
For the State Senate seat, which has no incumbent, he advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary with 59.5% of the vote.
